lines.text: 你不是来做选择的——你已经选好了。你来，是为了理解自己为什么这样选。
lines.en: You didn't come here to make the choice. You've already made it. You're here to understand why you made it.
lines.note: 先知把自由意志往后推一步：重装上阵与已刊《黑客帝国》《矩阵革命》不撞 id。通行定译。

lines.text: 希望——这是人类最典型的妄想。它既是人类最强大的力量，也是最大的弱点。
lines.en: Hope. It is the quintessential human delusion... the source of your enduring strength and weakness.
lines.note: 建筑师的终极论断；IMDb quotes 可查。

lines.text: 选择是幻觉——由有权者与无权者共同制造的幻觉。
lines.en: Choice is an illusion, created between those with power and those without.
lines.note: 梅罗文嘉的选择论；IMDb quotes 可查。
